notes: Per Republic, RQII and region, each month and each year (month = All).
avg_tariff = billed / gas sold. revenue_realization = collected / (gas purchased * avg_tariff) * 100.
opening_balance and closing_balance are billed minus collected, added up from Dec 2023. There is no balance in the file before that, so it starts at 0.
A year row uses the opening balance of the first month of that year and the closing balance of the last month.
BRQİİ and BRQSD are combined as BRQİİ / BRQSD.
Region-month source rows, including customers and gas loss, are in revenue-billing-performance.json.
